Hi Aditi —

Short technical clarification to include in the calc doc: during the 03:10–03:48 UTC window we saw increased scheduling delays on a subset of hosts due to an autoscaler race triggered by a noisy tenant. The runtime retried requests; those retries are flagged in the CSV. For the credit calc we excluded successful retries that completed within the customer-observed timeout threshold (i.e., end-to-end latency under SLA bound) and counted only requests that ultimately missed SLA.

I’ve added a 1-paragraph note and a small table to the spreadsheet describing retry handling (sheet "Assumptions").

Karthik
